headline: The vertical video takeover is here
summary: Vertical video format is dominating social and media platforms. The Stepback newsletter covers this essential tech story. David Pierce offers further insights on vertical video trends.

headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google VP Shakil Barkat indicated the Pixel 11 will be more expensive than its predecessor. RAM supply issues, driven by AI data centers, are cited as a reason. The price increase is not unexpected given market conditions.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Musician and journalist Oli Freke is known for his work on synthesizers and music theory. He's written a book detailing the evolution of synthesizers from 1963-1995. Freke prioritizes investing in a quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering offers unique grooveboxes that blend synthesizers, loopers, and effects. These devices allow real-time music production with distinctive designs. A wide selection of their products is currently 30 percent off.

headline: Kevin Feige Pushes Back at Criticisms That Dr. Doom Hasn't Had Thanos-Level Buildup
summary: Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige refutes claims that Dr. Doom lacks proper villain buildup. Critics argued Doom hasn't received Thanos-level development for his MCU role. Feige defends the character's introduction and future importance.

headline: Winston Duke Confirms That Yes, He Really Did Improvise That Iconic Line In Black Panther
summary: Winston Duke confirmed he improvised a memorable line in Black Panther. The line, spoken by his character M'Baku, became an iconic moment. His off-the-cuff delivery added humor to the film.

headline: 'I Would Stay at That Haunted Inn' — Widow's Bay Cast and Crew Are Just as Attached to the Island as the Rest of Us | Comic Con 2026
summary: The cast and crew of Apple TV's Widow's Bay spoke at Comic-Con 2026. They shared their deep affection for the show's fictional island setting. The panel discussed the series' unexpected success.

headline: The 4 Biggest Mysteries From Marvel's Comic-Con Panel | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel left fans with major unanswered questions. Mysteries include T'Challa's adult son and Ryan Reynolds' Ghost Rider role. The panel also fueled speculation about Deadpool's future.

headline: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
summary: A car rammed into a crowd at a Berlin Pride event on Saturday night. A police manhunt is actively underway for the suspect. The incident caused significant concern and injuries.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Prime Minister Burnham stated he would challenge Trump if it benefits Britain's national interest. He described his first conversation with the US president as positive. Burnham emphasized defending the UK's interests above all else.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated there would not be an early general election. He emphasized honoring the manifesto voters supported. Burnham made the declaration during an exclusive BBC interview.

headline: Gatwick Airport left without running water and working toilets after major outage
summary: Gatwick Airport experienced a major outage, losing running water and functional toilets. Bottled water is being distributed to passengers and staff. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the issue.
